title: introduce-flashadaptive-attn-adapter-with-rope-compensation-and-kv-priority-evict
author: Asha Patel
description: Context and motivation: Several customers and internal benchmarks showed inconsistent latency and throughput for long-context models when rotary and rope positional encodings were mixed across model families. The runtime was selecting a generic FlashAttention variant that did not account for rope compensation or token-importance for KV cache eviction, which led to suboptimal batching and premature KV spills under load. This PR introduces the FlashAdaptive adapter: a small compatibility layer + kernel selection glue that enables a fused rotary/rope compensation path, integrates a priority-aware KV eviction policy, and exposes scheduling hints to continuous-batcher so the runtime can pick the optimal kernel variant based on sequence distribution and quantization profile. What this PR does (single-string summary): Adds flash_adaptive kernel adapter and fused rope/rotary compensator, implements KV Priority Evict manager (recency + token-weight heuristic), hooks into continuous-batcher for policy-driven kernel routing, includes micro-benchmarks and integration tests, and ships a docs page with guidance and rollout feature-flag. Commits (high-level): - 7a1d2f: introduce flash_adaptive adapter interface and selection table; - 9c3b8e: implement fused_rope_rotary_compensator (CUDA + C++ wrapper) with numerics safeguards; - b2f9d1: kv/cache_priority_manager: implement eviction scoring and async prefetch hooks; - d4e7c3: continuous_batcher: expose scheduling hints and add policy binding for flash_adaptive; - 3f22a0: tests: add perf harnesses and unit tests for eviction heuristics; - 0b5c7f: docs: add docs/perf/flashadaptive.md and rollout checklist.
benchmarks_summary: Long-seq throughput (seq=2048, bs=8): +15% throughput vs master (flash-default) on A100-80GB
Medium-seq latency (seq=512, bs=16): P50 -5% latency and throughput +8%
benchmarks_notes: Representative numbers from internal perf harness: seq=512 (bs=16) P50 latency -5% and throughput +8%; seq=2048 (bs=8) throughput +12-18% depending on quantization; memory peak reduced ~6% due to fewer KV spills when eviction policy enabled. Numbers measured with feature-flag on vs off, averaged across 5 runs.
review_comments: Diego Ramos: Can you add a short note in the docs about numeric stability for mixed fp16/4-bit quantized models? I saw a small bias in the test harness for one of our 4-bit configs.

release_notes: Performance: Add FlashAdaptive attention adapter with fused rope/rotary compensator and a priority-aware KV eviction policy. Improvements for long context workloads: lower latency and higher throughput on A100/V100. Ops: feature-flag gating for Dedicated; rollout checklist in docs/perf/flashadaptive.md.
notes_for_release_engineering: Gate rollout behind kv.priority_evict.enabled and flashadaptive.runtime.enabled. We've added a permissive default for hosted (enabled) and default=false for Dedicated. Recommend canary in eu-west-1 on low-traffic namespace for 48h, then broaden. Update kernel signing pipeline to include new .cu artifacts.
